name: detect_lang

test_list.description: Every supported extension (rs, py/pyi, cpp/cc/cxx/hpp/hh/hxx, cu/cuh, ts/mts/cts) maps to its Lang.
.c and .h are parsed with the C++ grammar (C is close to a subset; documented deviation).
Upper-case extensions, spaces, non-ASCII names and Windows separators do not matter.
An extension-less script with a python shebang is Python.
A UTF-8 BOM before the shebang does not hide it.
A known extension takes precedence over the shebang.
Markdown, Makefile, a /bin/sh script and an empty path are not code-intel languages.
.tsx is not detected because the TypeScript grammar cannot parse JSX (limitation, deferred).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File path; only the extension is inspected.

inputs.name: head
inputs.description: First bytes of the file (shebang detection).

output_description: The language, or None when the file is not a supported source file.
